# Key schema

Fields of the tables modders edit most, generated from the database. `Rows` is how many rows hold the field out of the family's rows. `exe` is `path` when the dotted path appears in a game-DB reader, `leaf` when only its last part does, and `hash` when the full key hash is an immediate in the exe.
